sql = """

    ROUND(MIN(r.z), 3) AS min_level,

  AND r.tm >= '2024-02-01'

  AND r.z IS NOT NULL

            'avg': row['avg_level'],
            'max': row['max_level'],
            'min': row['min_level'],

        }
